reason: I have one or two chairs and I cut most of the hair myself, so selfie check-ins, stylist earnings and leave tracking are for a bigger salon. The WhatsApp reminders and wallet look modern, but paying ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month for a shop my size feels like too much when I already count the drawer myself every night.
objection: If my phone breaks or gets stolen, do I lose all my customer list and wallet balances? And ₹999 a month is close to twelve thousand a year for features I mostly won't use.
would_change_my_mind: A small-shop plan around ₹299-399 a month with no setup fee, just billing on WhatsApp, reminders and the wallet, with proof that my data is backed up online and comes back on a new phone.
